$comment: Allumino central resource database. One record per real-world resource a student can be pointed at. Region is a slash path, most-specific-last: COUNTRY/STATE-OR-PROVINCE/METRO. An empty region means online / open to anyone. A student in CA/ON/Toronto matches records at CA/ON/Toronto, CA/ON, CA and "". Adding a market = adding records, never code.
